card.title: IPhone 15 Pro Max Dead and Not Charging

source.title: IPhone 15 Pro Max Dead and Not Charging

claims.statement: An iPhone 15 Pro / Pro Max that seems dead on battery but boots on a DC supply (drawing 0.105–0.130 A before power-on) with the charging IC heating has a failed charging IC.
The charging IC location differs between the US and international variants.

procedure: Find the hot charging IC (thermal camera/rosin).
Split the board; replace the charging IC.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
